title: Dig gravel until the requested flint count is collected

order.text: creuse le gravier avec ta pelle Fortune III jusqu'à avoir ${n} silex

notes: Fortune III guarantees flint from manually mined gravel, avoiding a finite supply with an unbounded random drop requirement. Gravel sits on solid stone; no falling-block loot shortcut. Two spare blocks allow the inventory-based until condition to stop the skill.
